name: guesty-mcp-server
description: MCP server for Guesty property management — 43 registered tools (23 free read-only Guesty tools available today) + 7 addressable resource templates covering reservations, guests, messaging, pricing, revenue, tasks, webhooks, and IoT/property-health.

scripts.prepack: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const ok=['README.md','LICENSE'];const bad=fs.readdirSync('.').filter(f=>/^(README|LICEN[SC]E)/.test(f)&&!ok.includes(f));if(bad.length){console.error('PREPACK '+'ABORT: npm force-includes root README/LICENSE-prefixed files regardless of .npmignore. These WOULD be published: '+bad.join(', ')+'. Move them to _backups/.');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.test: rc=0; for t in tests/test-enterprise.js tests/test-iot.js tests/test-remote-toolsync.mjs; do echo "--- $t"; node "$t" || rc=1; done; exit $rc

author: DLJ Properties
